purpose: Build the planned scene in Blender step by step: units, shapes, modifiers, materials, lights, camera, preview, render or GLB export, with a JSON report per step.
triggers: set up the camera in Blender
which socket name does this Blender version use

exclusions.condition: the scene plan, camera, or lighting plan is not decided yet
no runtime path is ready or the user has not chosen one
GLB size, triangle, or texture budget questions

required.name: locked_scene_plan
required.description: Approved plan from blendops-scene-plan or blendops-product-shot: objects, sizes, materials, lights, camera, output

required.name: runtime_path
required.description: Ready runtime path from blendops-connect-blender: Path 1, Path 2, or CLI fallback

optional.name: blender_version
optional.description: Blender version from bpy.app.version; decides API names such as the EEVEE engine id

optional.name: output_targets
optional.description: Absolute output paths for preview, render, or GLB files

handoffs.label: Preview output exists; check it against the done criteria
A build step failed or the output looks wrong
Runtime is not ready for building
